description: A shareable resource adds the share check to the read scope

output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM `document` AS `document_view` WHERE ((`document_view`.`owner` = ? OR `document_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated') OR (`document_view`.`visibility` = 'shared' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `document_share` AS `s` WHERE `s`.`document_id` = `document_view`.`id` AND `s`.`can_read` AND (`s`.`user_id` = ? OR `s`.`user_group_id` IN (SELECT `m`.`user_group_id` FROM `user_group_membership` AS `m` WHERE `m`.`user_id` = ?))))))

SELECT
  `document_view`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `document_view`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `document_view`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `document_view`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`document_view`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `document_view`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `document_view`.`title` AS `title`
FROM `document` AS `document_view` WHERE ((`document_view`.`owner` = ? OR `document_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated') OR (`document_view`.`visibility` = 'shared' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `document_share` AS `s` WHERE `s`.`document_id` = `document_view`.`id` AND `s`.`can_read` AND (`s`.`user_id` = ? OR `s`.`user_group_id` IN (SELECT `m`.`user_group_id` FROM `user_group_membership` AS `m` WHERE `m`.`user_id` = ?)))))) ORDER BY `document_view`.`id` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
